title: BlackboardCompressionReport.v1
description: The receipt for losslessly compressing a converged blackboard (entries_before -> entries_after). Compression shrinks the entry surface ONLY if answer-critical lineage survives: source_handles_preserved and held_out_preserved are pinned const true — compression may NEVER drop provenance handles or held-out items (lossless distillation law; omitted/held-out != deleted). fidelity_note records the human-readable retention argument. Compression produces a new versioned derived layer; the raw entries + lineage remain rehydratable.

entries_after.description: entry count after compression (the derived layer; raw entries remain rehydratable)

source_handles_preserved.description: ALWAYS true — compression must preserve every source/provenance handle; dropping handles is forbidden by the lossless distillation law

held_out_preserved.description: ALWAYS true — compression must preserve held-out/minority/rejected items; omitted != deleted

fidelity_note.description: human-readable retention argument: what was merged, what was kept, why answer-critical facts survive
